description: Read the authenticated sandbox machine's own EUR-cent balance, spending limits, and latest ledger entries. Returns at most 100 ledger entries per call; pass offset=100, 200, ... to paginate when next_offset is present. Use fund_wallet to create a test funding checkout and set_wallet_limits to change limits; this read does neither.

offset.description: Zero-based ledger offset; use next_offset to fetch the next 100 entries.

name: get_wallet
title: Wallet balance and ledger
